reason: Catalog-only code release fixes an approved re-entry deadlock for legacy products whose first planning callback was not recorded. The API normalizes only active red-line A/B collaboration records that are already approved, have a positive planning request number, and have no publication history; the normalization and all existing version, cost, identity, three-field and whole-style atomic checks execute in one transaction. Repeated department-B approval is idempotent and does not increment the request batch. No schema, dependency, app configuration, business data or upload migration. Planning and Replenishment retain their accepted runtimes and processes. Intervening isolated-release scripts are reviewed bundled Catalog runtime dependencies already installed and attested by the pinned dispatcher; this application push does not replace dispatcher infrastructure.
